sources.WHO_EML: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines / WHO Model Formulary

medicines.name: Acetaminophen (paracetamol)
medicines.what: Lowers fever and reduces pain. It does not reduce inflammation.
mustKnow: Follow the dose and interval on the package
Taking it with cold medicines that contain the same ingredient can cause overdose
Be especially careful if you drink alcohol often or have liver disease

medicines.name: Ibuprofen
medicines.what: Reduces pain and fever and calms inflammation (swelling).
mustKnow: Take with food, not on an empty stomach (risk of stomach bleeding)
Avoid if dehydrated or if you have kidney disease
Don't take with other anti-inflammatory painkillers (such as aspirin)

medicines.name: Loperamide
medicines.what: Reduces how often diarrhoea comes. It does not treat the cause.
mustKnow: Don't take it if there is blood in the stool or a high fever
Don't give to children without checking with a medical worker
With diarrhoea, replacing fluids (oral rehydration) comes before medicine

medicines.name: Cetirizine
medicines.what: Reduces runny nose, sneezing, itching and hives.
mustKnow: It can make you drowsy. Be careful when you need to stay alert
For severe allergy — swollen lips or tongue, difficulty breathing — this medicine is not enough: get help right away

medicines.name: Povidone-iodine
medicines.what: Disinfects the skin around a wound.
mustKnow: Rinse the wound with clean water first, then apply around it
With iodine allergy or thyroid disease, don't use it on large areas for long
